_doc: M3: LTX-2.3 image-to-video from the picked batch-2 keyframes (scripts/clips.py, ComfyUI template video_ltx2_3_i2v). Prompt = motion + the shared clip style. 24 fps, 1280x720 (16:9; the template's half-res + 2x upscale). Seconds = the shot's length rounded up, 3-6 s; longer shots are slowed, held or recut at M4. Two seeds per clip. Picks go in 'kept' as {clip: path}.
style: 1970s 16mm caper film footage of practical puppet and miniature sets, burnt orange and teal palette, steady camera unless the motion says otherwise, smooth natural motion, puppets keep their shapes, no text, no logos

D02.motion: the hanging lamp swings slowly, its light sweeping across the table; the puppets lean in over the blueprint and point at it, nodding

D04e.motion: the van rolls slowly forward out of the garage toward the camera, headlights sweeping across the walls

D05.motion: the van rolls in from the left and pulls up to the curb, then stops; the street stays still

D08.motion: the camera pushes in fast toward the tangle of cords on the switchboard; a few cords sway

D09.motion: the puppet presses the stethoscope to the vault door and listens, then lowers it, shrugs its shoulders and turns away to the right

D10.motion: the line of puppets shuffles forward one step; the first puppet takes a paper ticket from the dispenser and steps aside

D11.motion: the ticker tape keeps streaming out of the vault; the puppets pull it in hand over hand along the line

D12.motion: amber liquid drips steadily from the copper coil into the little bottles, which fill one by one; the paper tape keeps feeding into the pot

D13.motion: the brass arm flings the puppet out the door; the puppet tumbles through the air and lands on the sidewalk

D15.motion: the puppets dance in a circle around the copper still, bouncing to a funky beat, steam rising from the still

D16.motion: glowing amber liquid pours through the mesh sieve into the copper bowl, rippling

D18.motion: the puppet drops coins one after another into the teller machine's slot; the machine's dials twitch

D19.motion: slow motion: the puppets stride toward the camera with crates of bottles on their shoulders, swaggering

D21.motion: half of the puppets in the line turn together in one move and step toward the shiny new chrome teller window

D22.motion: the ticker tape slowly spools out of the machine on the chaise onto the floor; the puppet in the armchair nods and writes on its clipboard

D23.motion: the faceless investigator holds the printout up toward the camera; the two masked puppets turn to each other and shrug

D25.motion: the cork pops off the little bottle and flies up; the two puppets jerk back, startled, then lean in and shush it

D27.motion: a huge crowd of puppets dances around the copper still, bouncing to a funky beat, steam billowing

D31.motion: the puppets shove more crates into the back of the van until the crates topple and the back doors swing wide open

D32.motion: the three figures stand still under the streetlight; the middle one slowly raises the memo; the streetlight flickers

D33.motion: the figures wheel the gold teller machine on its trolley across the stage and behind the red curtain

D34.motion: the puppets lift their glasses, swirl, sip, and all grimace together in unison

D35.motion: the gloved hands slide the two small bottles around each other on the green felt, swapping their places quickly like a shell game

D36.motion: the camera slowly pulls back from the vault across the wide marble hall

D38.motion: the probe rolls forward pushing the wheelbarrow of pages and waves one arm; the two puppets wave back

D39.motion: the warm light inside the paper house flickers; the teller machine inside rattles and shakes as if shouting

D39c.motion: the brass mechanical arm reaches slowly toward the gavel, hesitates, then pulls back away from it

D40.motion: the teal-masked puppets shuffle up to the counter and look over the bottles; the mustard-masked puppet behind the counter gestures at them

D41.motion: each figure hands its bottle to the figure on its right, who takes it and passes it on; the bottles travel hand to hand around the ring, again and again, while the camera circles slowly around them
D41.note: s41/s42 (v1 keyframe) read as holding, not passing (human, M4 notes); s43-s46 from the v2 keyframe

D42.motion: the knitted sock puppets dance in place around the copper still, bouncing and swinging their arms to a funky beat; the probe's green light pulses. Every puppet keeps its knitted ski mask and gray felt face with button eyes and no mouth; only puppets in the room, the background stays dark and empty, no people, no human faces
D42.note: s41/s42 rejected: realistic human faces appeared in the background crowd, and the teal puppets turned into white faces with red mouths (decision 4); s43/s44 (stricter prompt, same keyframe) still showed the people, which were in the keyframe; s45/s46 from keyframe D42_v2_s43

D42a.motion: the single round vault door swings slowly open on its one hinge, showing an empty glowing orange vault; nobody is inside and nobody comes out. The masked sock puppet turns and points at the coated felt figures, who keep pointing back at it. Only these three puppets in the scene, no people, no human faces
D42a.note: s41/s42 (v1 keyframe) showed two doors (human, M4 notes); s43-s46 (v2 keyframe) rejected: a human figure walked out of the vault in every take, a realistic man in a suit in s43 (guardrail); s47-s50 keep the vault empty

D42b.motion: the three figures in coats tap their feet; one lifts the bottle and takes a quick sip, then freezes, still

D44a.motion: the puppet at the podium slowly shakes its head from side to side; the rest of the crew stand perfectly still

D44c.motion: the camera slowly pulls back along the long line of puppets on the night street; the teller window glows

D14.motion: shadow puppetry on the wall: the leftmost shadow head droops, goes limp and drops out of sight; then two new shadow heads sprout from the same stump and rise up tall side by side, mouths snapping; the other shadow heads sway; the camera holds still
D14.note: new at M4: the still did not read as multiplication (human, M4 notes); D14 becomes a Clip
